verdict.rationale: Scheduled or recurring automation is a fair question for an online tax-filing and payment portal, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only shows one-off, user-initiated actions such as filing returns, making payments and adding a payment plan. Nothing documents user-configurable background automations, recurring schedules, or an API (OpenAPI probes returned 404, and the transactional portal blocks agents with a 403).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
